title: Getting Persist Notes ready
lead: On first launch, the app sets everything up to transcribe meetings on this computer. It takes a few minutes, depending on your connection.
wait: Persist Notes continues as soon as local transcription and the model are ready.

whisper.title: Local transcription
whisper.errMissing: The transcription program is missing from the app. Download and reinstall Persist Notes from the website.
whisper.errTest: The transcription program did not work on this computer. Click Try again; if it keeps failing, download and reinstall Persist Notes from the website.

model.title: Transcription model (~550 MB)
model.errOffline: No internet connection. Check your network and click Try again: the download resumes where it stopped.
model.errServer: The model server did not respond. Try again in a few minutes: the download resumes where it stopped.
model.errHash: The downloaded file was damaged and has been discarded. Click Try again.

claude.title: Claude Code (for summaries and Ask)
claude.why: Summaries and Ask use your Claude subscription, through Claude Code installed on this computer. Recording and transcription work without it.
claude.termInstall: Installing Claude Code with the official Anthropic command...
claude.termAfterInstall: Done. Go back to Persist Notes and click Sign in.
claude.termLogin: Opening Claude Code. Sign in with your Claude account, then go back to Persist Notes.
